purpose: Shows one reading against a known range, such as workspace health, a quota or a score, on a 270° arc with the value, unit and label in the middle.

notFor.case: Progress of a long operation in a row.

Variant=default.visual: Arc in Chart/series-1/solid on a Surface/muted track; value Content/primary, unit Content/secondary, label Chart/series-1/content.

a11y.reducedMotion: Instant: a new value no longer sweeps the arc on use-travel-in.
notes: aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and an aria-valuetext that reads the label ("72 %, Healthy").
Needs an accessible name (aria-label or aria-labelledby).
Use success · warning · critical only when the colour carries the meaning, never to decorate.

openQuestions: The contract has no Figma set (codeOnly, finding DOC-001 Gauge). Is a Figma set planned, or is code the owner here?
Who picks success · warning · critical: fixed bands on the range, or the app for each reading?
